spending_entity: Ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et du Numérique
purpose: The ministry's digital-economy programme: transfers to the state digital agency and digital investment including the connectivity and technology-park projects, excluding staff costs.
scope_basis: A programme of the digital ministry whose title and content are the digital economy; in 2025 it also carries the governance and connectivity work split out as programme 2133 in 2026.
amount_scale: billions of FCFA, two decimals for the voted figure (RTEB T1 2025 Annexe 2) and one decimal for the outturn (RTEB T4 2025 Annexe 2); stored normalised to units
doc_locator: RTEB 1er trimestre 2025, Annexe 2 (situation par ministère, programme et catégorie au 31 mars 2025), PDF p. 4, programme Economie numérique, column LFI, categories 3, 4 and 5; actual from RTEB au 31 décembre 2025, Annexe 2 (par ministère et programme), PDF p. 39, column Crédits PEC
notes: Domestic credits excluding personnel, as both annexes print them (T1 2025 Annexe 2 LFI column totals 2,810.47bn = the LFI's other current spending 1,930.5 plus capital on internal resources 880.0). Voted: goods and services 0.06, transfers 8.25, investment 1.34 = 9.65bn. Reconciliation: the LFR 2025 Annexe III (PDF p. 67) restates the LFI column as personnel 218,557,000 (not held), goods and services 57,610,651, transfers 8,250,000,000 and investment 22,611,379,999, total 31,137,547,650 all sources, which is also the figure the scanned LFI 2025 Annexe III prints (PDF p. 45, read off the rotated page); categories 3 and 4 equal the annexe, so about 21.27bn of the investment is externally financed (external.csv). Outturn: T4 2025 prints credits opened 9.3bn and PEC 8.6bn for the programme, both domestic non-personnel; the rate is against the initial vote. Revised: the LFR 2025 (Loi 2025-10) cuts the programme to 26,601,032,828 all sources with no origin split, and the second LFR 2025 is held only as a bill, so no revised stage is held.
